versions.content: For each prototype of a software component type that supports multiple instantiation, the RTE generator shall set the value of the element Instance_Id from 0 to N-1 according to the number (N) of software component prototypes and according to the names of the software component prototypes sorted alphabetically (ASCII / ISO 8859-1 code in ascending order).
